audience: Bulgarian businesses who issue invoices with inv.bg

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices, oldest first
useCases.text: The AI lists documents by payment status, client and issue date, with totals and balance due, and puts the oldest first.

useCases.title: See everything invoiced to a client
useCases.text: The AI finds a client and lists the documents issued to them in a date range, and adds up the totals.

useCases.title: Find bank transactions not linked to an invoice
useCases.text: The AI lists imported bank transactions and picks the ones that are not linked to a document, which helps with reconciliation.

useCases.title: Create a draft invoice for a client
useCases.text: The AI creates an invoice, proforma or credit note saved as a draft, using your items, number set and VAT reasons.

useCases.title: Add or update a client, or add an item
useCases.text: The AI adds a company client with Bulstat, VAT and address, or updates one, and adds a product or service to the catalogue.

useCases.title: Email an invoice or record a payment
useCases.text: The AI emails a document to a recipient, which cannot be recalled, or records a payment received and allocates it to a document.
